name: @kitora/tabster
description: Kitora's tabbed dock, a preset on @kitora/dock: panels, persistence adapters, group names, outliner, arrange overlay and keyboard handling.

exports.name: Tabster
exports.description: A VS Code-style tabbed dock on `@kitora/dock`: a panel registry, saved layouts through an adapter, edit mode and group-label chips.

props.name: panels
props.description:
Map of `component` name → React component (or lazy wrapper). Lookup
happens when a panel mounts: the `component` field on each
`TabsterPanelSpec` indexes into this map.

Memoize this object if you build it in a parent render — a new
identity tears down + remounts every panel.

props.name: initialPanels
props.description:
Panels to mount on first render. Used when:
  - no adapter is wired
  - the adapter returned `null` (no saved snapshot)
  - the adapter snapshot failed schema migration / restore

props.name: initialLayout
props.description:
Pre-baked layout JSON to restore on mount. Useful for routes that
receive a layout from props / URL. Falls back to `initialPanels`
on parse failure. Adapter snapshots take precedence when both are
present.

props.name: adapter
props.description:
Persistence backend. When provided, Tabster:
  - loads on boot (and runs migrators if `version` differs)
  - auto-saves on every layout change (debounced if `persistDebounceMs > 0`)

Adapter is optional — Tabster works fine without one.

props.name: version
props.description:
Current schema version Tabster writes. Bump when you make a
breaking change to the layout shape. Snapshots loaded at a lower
version are routed through `migrators[from]` chain by chain up to
this number.

props.name: migrators
props.description:
Map of `from-version` → migrator function. Each migrator takes
the snapshot at version N and returns version N + 1. Tabster
chains them automatically.

props.name: autoPersist
props.description:
Auto-persist to the adapter on every layout change. Defaults to
`true` when an adapter is provided. Set to `false` for explicit
Save / Discard semantics — use `api.enterEditMode()` + friends.

props.name: panelFallback
props.description:
`<Suspense>` fallback shown while a `lazy()` panel resolves its
dynamic import. Default: `null` (blank). Tabster also wraps each
panel in an error boundary; `panelErrorFallback` covers the
"import failed / threw at render" cases.

props.name: panelErrorFallback
props.type: (info: { error: Error reset: () => void panelId: string }) => ReactNode
props.description:
Render override for the per-panel error boundary. One panel's
render-time throw is caught here and won't crash the rest of the
dock. Receives `{ error, reset, panelId }` — call `reset()` to
remount the panel subtree.

Default ships a small error card with a Reset button.

props.name: persistDebounceMs
props.description:
Coalesce a burst of layout changes into a single adapter save.
Useful for server-backed adapters where every drag-resize tick
shouldn't hit the network. Default `0` = save immediately.

In-flight debounced saves flush on unmount so nothing is lost.

props.name: onReady
props.description:
Called once the dock has booted and the imperative API is
usable. Store `event.api` in a ref for later imperative work.
Tabster's `<TabsterProvider>` auto-publishes the api too, so the
outliner / arrange overlay receive it without a ref.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description:
Fires on every structural change (add / remove / move / resize).
Wire to URL state, breadcrumb, dirty indicator. Tabster also
routes this to the adapter — you don't need to save manually.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description:
Fires when a different tab gains focus. `null` when the dock
becomes empty. Use for breadcrumb, URL, analytics, "now editing X".

props.name: onPanelClose
props.description:
App-level hook for panel close. Fires AFTER the dock removes the
panel — by this point the panel React tree is already unmounted,
so use this for telemetry / breadcrumbs / persisting list state.

For per-panel teardown (closing a terminal session etc) prefer
`useTabsterPanelClose` inside the panel component — no id-prefix
dispatch needed.

props.name: onRestore
props.description:
Fires after a snapshot is loaded from the adapter (boot, or
`api.reload()`). Use for toast notifications ("layout restored")
or to read `snapshot.meta`.

props.name: defaultRenderer
props.description:
Default `TabsterPanelRenderer` strategy for every panel. Override
per-panel via `TabsterPanelSpec.renderer`. Default:
`'onlyWhenVisible'`. Set to `'always'` if most
of your panels are session-owners (terminals etc).

props.name: theme
props.description:
Light / dark / auto. The dock reads Kitora tokens through its
`--dock-*` variables; `dark` scopes the dark tokens to Tabster's root.
Override any `--dock-*` variable in your own stylesheet.

props.name: keyboard
props.description:
Custom keyboard shortcuts. Pass `false` to disable all shortcuts
(useful when embedded inside another keyboard-heavy UI). Partial
overrides merge with defaults — pass just `{ closeTab: 'mod+x' }`
to remap one action.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className on Tabster's root element.

props.name: footer
props.description:
Slot rendered below the dock area. Use for status bars, sticky
"save layout" indicators, edit-mode toolbars, etc.

props.name: groupHeaderPrefix
props.description:
Renders BEFORE the tab strip of every group. Use for colored
group labels, pin / lock indicators, drag handles. Tabster ships
`createTabsterGroupLabel(store)` for the common case; under a
`<TabsterProvider>` this is auto-bound and you can omit the prop.

props.name: groupHeaderSuffix
props.description:
Renders AFTER the tab strip — right-side actions. Use for a
per-group split / settings button.

exports.name: TabsterProps
exports.description:
Props for the main `<Tabster>` component.

Minimum viable mount:

  <Tabster
    panels={{ editor: EditorPanel }}
    initialPanels={[{ id: 'a', component: 'editor', title: 'a.tsx' }]}
  />

Common additions:
  - `adapter={createLocalStorageAdapter({ key: 'my-app:dock' })}`
  - `<TabsterProvider>` wrapper for outliner / arrange overlay siblings
  - `onReady={({ api }) => apiRef.current = api}` for imperative access
  - `persistDebounceMs={300}` for server-backed adapters

exports.name: TabsterPanelRenderProps
exports.description:
What a panel component receives: the dock's `PanelProps` — `id`,
`title`, `isActive`, the dock's `api` — with `params`
typed by the caller. Before the move off dockview this was dockview's
`IDockviewPanelProps` (`props.api.title` is now `props.title`; the dock's
`api` is the container api dockview called `containerApi`).

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's tab title.

props.name: id
props.description: The panel's id.

props.name: api
props.description: The dock's imperative API, e.g. to rename or close this panel.

props.name: isActive
props.description: The panel is its group's visible tab. Kept-alive hidden panels stay mounted with this false.

props.name: params
props.description: The panel's params as the caller declared them; stored as JSON, so non-JSON values do not survive a save.

exports.name: TabsterPanelPosition
exports.description: Where to open a panel: beside or inside a reference panel or group (`direction`, tab `index`), or at an edge of the whole dock.

exports.name: TabsterDirection
exports.description:
Where a new panel goes, relative to a panel's group, a group, or the whole
dock (the shape dockview's `position` had, so specs written for it still
place panels the same way). `within` joins the group as a tab; a side opens
a new group beside it.

exports.name: TabsterApi
exports.description:
Imperative handle Tabster hands you via `onReady`. Stable for the
lifetime of the `<Tabster>` instance.

The bits we promise to keep working when internals change. Reach for
`api.raw()` (the dock's `DockApi`) only when you need something not yet
wrapped.

exports.name: TabsterPanelSpec
exports.description:
Descriptor for a single panel to add via `initialPanels` or
`api.addPanel`.

Generics:
  - `P`  Narrows `params` per panel type.
  - `C`  Narrows the `component` field to a union of valid keys —
         pass `keyof typeof PANELS & string` (or use the
         `defineTabsterPanels` helper) to get autocomplete + catch
         typos at compile time. Default `string` keeps the loose
         backwards-compatible shape.

exports.name: TabsterPanelComponent
TabsterPanelEntry
exports.description:
Value type for entries in `Tabster.panels`. Either an eager component
or a `React.lazy()` wrapper — Tabster mounts every panel inside
`<Suspense>` so lazy panels just work:

  panels: {
    editor: EditorPanel,
    notes: lazy(() => import('./notes')),
  }

We deliberately don't support bare `() => import(...)` factories —
a zero-arg React component would have the same shape and crash on
render when wrapped in `React.lazy()`. Wrap explicitly.

exports.name: TabsterPanelParams
exports.description:
Default params shape for a panel. `unknown` values force callers to
narrow at the use site instead of trusting an `any`. Pass a tighter
shape as the generic when you want type-safe `props.params` access.

exports.name: TabsterPanelRenderer
exports.description:
Render strategy controlling when a panel is mounted vs unmounted.

  - `'always'`           Mount on add, keep mounted across tab
                         switches. Use for terminals, websockets,
                         video, iframes — anything that owns long-
                         lived state you don't want to recreate.
                         (The dock's `eager` lifecycle.)
  - `'onlyWhenVisible'`  Mount on activation, unmount when hidden.
                         Tabster's default. Cheap for stateless tabs.
                         (The dock's `unmount-when-hidden`.)

Closing a panel (`api.removePanel`) always unmounts, regardless. Use
`useTabsterPanelClose` or a `useEffect` cleanup to tear down the
underlying session / connection / subscription.

exports.name: TabsterTheme
exports.description: Light / dark / auto theme switch. Auto follows the parent Kitora theme.

exports.name: TabsterKeyboardMap
exports.description:
Keyboard map overrides — pass one shortcut or an array of equivalents
per action (combine ctrl + cmd keys for cross-platform), in
`@kitora/keyboard`'s grammar (`Mod+K W`, `Ctrl+PageDown`); the old
react-hotkeys-hook spelling (`ctrl+k+w`) is still read.

Pass `keyboard={false}` to `<Tabster>` to disable every shortcut
(e.g. when embedding inside another keyboard-heavy UI).

exports.name: TabsterReadyEvent
exports.description: Event payload for `<Tabster onReady>`.

exports.name: TabsterGroupHeaderProps
exports.description:
What `groupHeaderPrefix` / `groupHeaderSuffix` components receive: the
group (with `api.id`, as dockview's header props had), its panels, the
active one, whether it is the dock's active group, and the dock's api.

props.name: api
props.description: The group's id under `api.id` (dockview's header-props shape, so existing headers keep working).

props.name: group
props.description: The group's node in the dock layout.

props.name: panels
props.description: The group's panels, in tab order.

props.name: activePanel
props.description: The group's active panel, if any.

props.name: isGroupActive
props.description: Whether this group is the dock's active group.

props.name: containerApi
props.description: The dock's api, for actions such as opening or splitting panels.

exports.name: TabsterAdapter
exports.description:
Storage backend contract — implement to plug Tabster into:

  - localStorage   (use `createLocalStorageAdapter`)
  - in-memory      (use `createInMemoryAdapter` for tests)
  - IndexedDB, OPFS, REST, GraphQL — write your own

Async is fine. Tabster catches throw/reject and falls back to
`initialPanels` — `load` cannot crash the dock.

exports.name: TabsterSnapshot
exports.description:
Serializable snapshot that travels between Tabster and its storage
adapter. Bump `version` on schema-breaking changes; register a
matching `TabsterMigrator` so old saves keep working.

exports.name: TabsterMigrator
exports.description:
Migrator for moving a snapshot from version `from` to `from + 1`.
Tabster chains migrators in order from the stored version up to
`TabsterProps.version`. Returning `null` or throwing aborts the
chain and Tabster falls back to `initialPanels`.

exports.name: TabsterMigratorMap
exports.description: Migrator map keyed by `from` version.

exports.name: SerializedLayout
exports.description: Opaque type — the dock's serialized layout (`@kitora/dock` schema).

exports.name: MaybePromise
exports.description: Helper — adapter mutators can be sync or async.

exports.name: createInMemoryAdapter
exports.description: A Tabster adapter that keeps the last saved snapshot in memory, with `peek()` to read it; for tests or your own persistence.

exports.name: createLocalStorageAdapter
exports.description: A Tabster adapter that saves the snapshot as JSON under a `tabster:`-prefixed key in `localStorage` (or the `storage` you pass); SSR safe, storage errors go to `onError`.

exports.name: InMemoryAdapterOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createInMemoryAdapter}.

exports.name: LocalStorageAdapterOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createLocalStorageAdapter}.

exports.name: createGroupNamesStore
exports.description: Creates a store of user-facing group names (group id to name) that broadcasts changes, so the chip, outliner and arrange tiles stay in sync.

exports.name: TabsterGroupNamesStore
exports.description:
Tabster — group naming store.

Dock groups don't carry user-facing names by default. This store
maps group ids → human names and broadcasts changes so the dock chip,
outliner row, and arrange tile stay in sync.

Each `<TabsterOutliner>` / `<Tabster>` pair should share one store.
Caller creates it once and threads it through every consumer.

exports.name: CreateGroupNamesStoreOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createGroupNamesStore}: the default-name pattern and seed names.

exports.name: defineTabsterPanels
exports.description:
Identity wrapper that preserves the registry's exact key types and
pairs them with a `spec` factory for typesafe spec construction.
The returned `panels` field is what you pass to `<Tabster panels>`.
exports.signature: <const T extends Record<string, TabsterPanelEntry>>(panels: T) => TabsterPanelRegistry<T>

exports.name: TabsterPanelKey
exports.description:
Extract the literal key union from a panel registry. Use to
parameterize `TabsterPanelSpec`.

  const PANELS = defineTabsterPanels({ editor, terminal })
  type Key = TabsterPanelKey<typeof PANELS>   // 'editor' | 'terminal'

exports.name: TabsterPanelRegistry
exports.description: Output of `defineTabsterPanels`. The registry plus a `spec` helper.

exports.name: TabsterPanelSpecInput
exports.description:
Per-spec input shape — same as `TabsterPanelSpec` but with the
`component` field narrowed to the registry's key union.

exports.name: TabsterProvider
exports.description: Context root that shares one Tabster api, group-names store and dock-host ref with `<Tabster>`, `<TabsterOutliner>` and `<TabsterArrangeOverlay>` below it.

props.name: children
props.description: The `<Tabster>`, `<TabsterDockHost>` and sibling tools (outliner, arrange overlay) that share this context.

props.name: namesStore
props.description:
Inject your own group-naming store (e.g. one shared across routes,
or seeded from a server snapshot). Defaults to a fresh store
created on mount.

props.name: namesStoreOptions
props.description:
Options forwarded to `createGroupNamesStore` when no store is
injected. Tune the default-name pattern (`(n) => 'Editor ' + n`)
or seed initial names here.

exports.name: TabsterDockHost
exports.description:
Positioned wrapper that registers itself as the provider's `hostRef`.
`<TabsterArrangeOverlay>` positions its tiles relative to this element.
Defaults to `relative min-w-0 flex-1` so callers can drop it inside
any flex row without further classes.

props.name: children
props.description: Tabster + any overlays (e.g. `<TabsterArrangeOverlay>`).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className. Merged with the default `relative min-w-0 flex-1`.

exports.name: useTabsterContext
exports.description: Read the live context. Throws if used outside a provider.

exports.name: useOptionalTabsterContext
exports.description: Same as `useTabsterContext` but returns null instead of throwing.

exports.name: TabsterContextValue
exports.description:
Shape of the Tabster context. Sibling components (Outliner, Arrange
overlay, custom group header) read this through `useTabsterContext()`
or `useOptionalTabsterContext()` rather than receiving props from
the caller.

props.name: children
props.description: The `<Tabster>`, `<TabsterDockHost>` and sibling tools (outliner, arrange overlay) that share this context.

props.name: namesStore
props.description:
Inject your own group-naming store (e.g. one shared across routes,
or seeded from a server snapshot). Defaults to a fresh store
created on mount.

props.name: namesStoreOptions
props.description:
Options forwarded to `createGroupNamesStore` when no store is
injected. Tune the default-name pattern (`(n) => 'Editor ' + n`)
or seed initial names here.

props.name: children
props.description: Tabster + any overlays (e.g. `<TabsterArrangeOverlay>`).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className. Merged with the default `relative min-w-0 flex-1`.

exports.name: useTabsterPanel
exports.description:
Read the panel's render props (id / title / params / isActive / api).
Throws if used outside a Tabster panel.

exports.name: useOptionalTabsterPanel
exports.description: Returns null instead of throwing — handy for shared components.

exports.name: useTabsterPanelApi
exports.description:
The panel's own handle from the dock (`id`, `isActive`, `isVisible`,
`close()`, `setTitle()`). It was dockview's panel api before the move to
`@kitora/dock`.

exports.name: useTabsterContainerApi
exports.description: The dock's api — open a sibling tab from inside a panel without threading refs.

exports.name: useTabsterPanelParams
exports.description: The current panel's params, typed as `P`; throws outside a Tabster panel.

exports.name: useTabsterPanelClose
exports.description:
Run a callback when this panel is closed.

Implementation: the dock unmounts the panel component on close, so we
piggy-back on React's `useEffect` cleanup. Use this when you don't
want to scatter `useEffect(() => () => …, [])` everywhere — the
latest-handler-ref pattern is built in so closure freshness is safe.

  useTabsterPanelClose(() => {
    terminal.session.close()
    ws.close()
  })

Note: with `renderer: 'onlyWhenVisible'` (Tabster's default) this
also fires on tab switch. Use `renderer: 'always'` for long-lived
panels (terminals, websockets) so this only runs on real close.

exports.name: useTabsterPanelVisible
exports.description: Subscribe to visibility (active tab vs hidden behind another tab or a maximised group).

exports.name: useTabsterPanelActive
exports.description: Subscribe to the active state of just this panel (its group's visible tab or not).

exports.name: TabsterPanelContextValue
exports.description: What the per-panel context holds: the panel's render props (id, title, params, isActive, the dock's api).

exports.name: TABSTER_GROUP_PALETTE
exports.description: The six group colors (`dot` and `chip` Tailwind classes) that {@link paletteFor} picks from.

exports.name: paletteFor
exports.description: The palette entry for a group id: a stable hash, so the same id always gets the same color.

exports.name: TabsterPaletteEntry
exports.description:
Tabster — group color palette.

Stable hash → palette mapping so the same group id always lands on
the same color across the dock chip, outliner row, arrange tile, and
move-popover heading. Chip text is the 800 shade in light mode: the chip
text is 10px over a 15% tint of the strip, where the 700 shade of amber
and rose falls below WCAG AA contrast.

exports.name: DOCKVIEW_MIGRATOR
exports.description:
The dock migrator for dockview saves: schema 0 (no `version`) → 1. JSON at
schema 0 that is not dockview's passes through unchanged for the dock's
restore to validate.

exports.name: isDockviewLayout
exports.description: True when `json` is a layout dockview saved (a `grid` with a `root`, and a `panels` map).

exports.name: migrateDockviewLayout
exports.description:
Converts a dockview `SerializedDockview` into a dock layout (schema 1).
Throws on input that is not dockview JSON; the dock's `restore` turns a
throw inside a migrator into a `rejected` result, so a broken save never
replaces the live layout.

exports.name: TabsterInlineRename
exports.description: An autofocused rename input that commits on Enter or blur and cancels on Escape; used by the outliner rows.

props.name: initial
props.description: Initial value loaded into the input on mount.

props.name: onCommit
props.description:
Called when the user presses Enter or blurs the input. Receives
the raw (untrimmed) value — caller decides what to do with empty
input.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user presses Escape — no value passed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra className. Merged with the default `flex-1 rounded …`.

props.name: selectOnMount
props.description: Whether to select the text on mount (so typing replaces it).

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for the input. Defaults to `Rename <initial>`, naming
the tab or group being renamed (plain `Rename` when `initial` is empty),
so a screen reader announces what the field edits (axe `label`).

props.name: initial
props.description: Initial value loaded into the input on mount.

props.name: onCommit
props.description:
Called when the user presses Enter or blurs the input. Receives
the raw (untrimmed) value — caller decides what to do with empty
input.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user presses Escape — no value passed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra className. Merged with the default `flex-1 rounded …`.

props.name: selectOnMount
props.description: Whether to select the text on mount (so typing replaces it).

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for the input. Defaults to `Rename <initial>`, naming
the tab or group being renamed (plain `Rename` when `initial` is empty),
so a screen reader announces what the field edits (axe `label`).

exports.name: createTabsterGroupLabel
exports.description:
Returns a component bound to the given names store. Wire as
Tabster's `groupHeaderPrefix`.

exports.name: TabsterGroupLabelOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createTabsterGroupLabel}: the chip's class and what to show for an unnamed group.

exports.name: TabsterOutliner
exports.description: A tree of the live dock (groups and their panels) with rename, add, delete, focus, drag-move and maximize; shown docked or floating.

props.name: api

exports.name: TABSTER_OUTLINER_RENAME_COMMAND
exports.description:
F2 renames the focused row, the platform's rename key (Windows Explorer,
VS Code, the sidebar kit's NavTree): the keyboard twin of double-clicking a
name. It is a `@kitora/keyboard` command, so it shows
in a host's cheatsheet and can be rebound, and it fires only while focus is
inside this outliner (a `data-kb-scope` plus the rule's `when`) and never
from a text field (the rename input keeps F2).

exports.name: TabsterOutlinerMode
exports.description:
Outliner display mode.
  - `'dock'`   Inline 280px aside docked on the right.
  - `'float'`  Draggable floating panel, portaled to `<body>`.

`'hidden'` is represented in the caller's state — pass it to
`onModeChange`, and conditionally unmount the outliner yourself.

exports.name: TabsterOutlinerPanelType
exports.description:
A panel type available in the outliner's per-group `+` menu. The
outliner uses this catalog both to render the picker and to mint
new ids when the user adds a panel.

exports.name: TabsterArrangeOverlay
exports.description: Edit-layout mode over the dock: dims it and draws one draggable tile per group, dropped on another tile's edge or center to move the group.

props.name: api
props.description:
Live Tabster api. Optional — falls back to the api published by
an ancestor `<TabsterProvider>`.

props.name: hostRef
props.description:
Ref to the positioned wrapper element around the dock. The overlay
computes its tile rects relative to this. Falls back to
`<TabsterDockHost>`'s ref when omitted.

props.name: namesStore
props.description:
Shared group-naming store — used to render each tile's name + dot
color. Falls back to the provider's store.

props.name: active
props.description:
Toggle the overlay. When `false`, renders nothing and removes the
dim class. Wire to your own "Arrange mode" button.

props.name: tabsterRootRef
props.description:
Ref to the element that should receive the `tabster-arrange-mode`
class (which dims the panels' content via shipped CSS). Falls
back to the dock-host ref. Pass a separate ref to dim a larger
area than just the dock.

props.name: dimClassName
props.description:
Tailwind classes for the full-bleed dim layer behind tiles. Override
for stronger dim, no backdrop blur, etc.
